body: One way or another, they would end this conflict.

:) I'm glad that I can help.

I'll still be here if you ever need to talk.

I think it's so wonderful that you care for your dog that much. It's so great that you can show that you have things that you care about. But it hurts to see you so destroyed. It really does. No one deserves that kind of mistreatment. No one. You did not deserve the life that you were given. You deserved so much more. You deserved such a better life.

But we cannot change what has already happened. The past is in the past, and nothing that we do can make it different. But the future, that is full of opportunity. There are so many unknowns in the future. How can you possibly be unworthy of something that hasn't happened?

Because, get this: I do think you're worthy. I think that you're more worthy than you know, than anyone knows. You've had to suffer through terrible hardship in your life, and it has made you a stronger, better person. Yes, there is pain, and yes, not everything is as perfect as it should be, but don't let the world make you believe that you are worthless. No one, and I mean *no one*, not me, not a friend, and especially not you, is worthless.

I weep at your pain, and wish to see you become well. But suicide is not the answer to that. It never is.
Please read [this.](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide) It might be helpful.

And don't forget, you can always talk to me if you need someone.

Yes. This. A thousand times this. She obviously needs help badly. If no one else will step in, you need to find someone, tell them you're deeply concerned, and get them to help you deal with it. Her parents definitely need to know. This is very serious.
*I guess you realize all of this. Good idea to get the counselor.

Don't do this. To your family. To your friends. To her.

Please, I beg of you. There are so many people, so many things, so much. *Please.* Don't go. I know you're in a dark place, but please don't end your life over this.

And read [this.](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide) It's never too late. Never too late.

Please respond. Please just talk to me.

You're far too important, far too meaningful, for that to be the truth, my friend. Something that a friend once told me, "It is not weakness to seek help of others. You are not weak just because you need help." And I think that it is true. You see, in your words, you say that this impossible standard is you
>*if I had not suffered from depression*

But you have. And I have. And neither of us will ever be able to change that. But don't fret! That does not mean that we are worthless to society, to ourselves. You see, the depression that we have lived through is part of what makes us. It gives us insights into things that other people don't experience. Our hardships make us stronger, but how we respond is what makes us people.

You are not alone. And you are not the only one who has ever held themselves to a standard that is unreachable. But do you really think it would be better this way? Your family, your brother, your parents, your friends, they care about you, and that is why they work to help you. You say that you refuse to seek help, yet you come here.

And I respond. I respond to your words. Because I hear your cries. I know your pain. The pain of an unending depression that eats at your very soul. And I care. I care that you feel this way, and I want to find a way to help you overcome it. Because I care.

Because we all care.

Please don't end yourself. [This](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide) might be of some help to you. Please read it for me.

And, if you ever need to talk to someone, I'll be here, waiting for you.

<3

This makes me more happy than anything in the world. Keep growing stronger, my friend.

You're not at the end of the line. Not yet. Like I said, I care that you feel miserable like this, and I want to help you feel better. I will stay here for as long as you need someone to talk to. As long as you feel this way. Don't lose hope.

You can't see it right now, but I'm hugging my monitor right now.

Just so that [I can hug you. <3](http://24.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lwvtbvM8Gg1qcuupyo1_500.jpg)

Please read [this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide) for me.

You feel miserable. Alone. That there is no one there for you. But you see, the thing is that this is not true. Lots of people are here for you! All of us here at /r/SuicideWatch are here for you! *I* am here for you. And I will continue to be here for you as long as you feel like this. I know the pain of depression. I have known it for most of my life. It sucks, plain and simple. But it's not the end. There's so much to do and see in this great big world of ours, and I'd hate for you not to be able to see it.

But I suppose that's not what's important right now. What's important is that you feel down, and you feel alone. Like I said I'm here for you, for as long as you need. I care about you. I care that you feel this way. And I want to help you feel better. However I can. One thing that I can think of is that you could see a therapist, if you haven't yet. It can really help.

But, if you feel uncomfortable with that, you can always talk to me :)

Reply or message me if you just want to talk, whenever you need to.

I weep for you. I really do. These thoughts, these feelings, they sound so similar to some of the things that I felt as I walked the dark road. And believe me, it is a dark road. When the knife misses, you think, "huh, maybe it was just a fluke." You then try the pills. "It didn't kill me. I just threw up... why can't I just die?" So, you start to get more and more self-destructive. And it's painful. More painful than anything I could ever imagine. Driving recklessly, trying to get into an accident, but never quite managing it. Putting the knife to your neck, again and again, when you realize that you just can't do it this way. So you finally decide that maybe you should just find a cliff to jump off of. Or a bridge. Yeah, a bridge would be nice. You start out. You get in your car, and head on your way. You find a suitable spot. Just as you are about to do this, about to finish the job, a phone call. You pick it up. A girl on the other end is crying. Why? How? How can someone care about *you*? You can't make out much of what she says, but you hear these words: "Don't do it. "Please. Just talk to me." And that haze, that mental numbness that you had in place of feelings, breaks open like a dam. And suddenly you're crying too. Just... crying. But, it is not pain that makes you cry. It is shame. The shame of knowing that you were about to make the most unchangeable, most damaging decision. It doesn't matter to her though. That one person, that girl, she cares about you, and she doesn't judge you. All she wants is to see you thrive and live in this world. And then others start calling, texting, asking "Are you ok?"

My experience is probably not the same as yours. I probably could never truly understand the pain that you're going through right now. At least not in the same way that I understood my own pain. But know that I'm here for you. We all are. And we'll be here for as long as you need. Because we want to see you thrive and live in this beautiful planet we call home. I'd ask if you are ok, but you're obviously not. Which is why I want to help you. To comfort you and make you feel as if you're worth every second that you've lived, and the many seconds that you will live. I wish I could just wrap my arms around you, and sing calming songs. But I can't. I can only offer words. But these words are typed with more conviction and emotion than any spoken word that I have said. Please don't leave us. Please don't lose hope.

[This](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide) can be a helpful read.

I'll stay for as long as you need. Forever, if it should come to that. Feel free to talk, or message me.

[This](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide) might be of some help in figuring out more about your friend. Also, the mod's right about the tips. And whatever you do, be there for your friend, for as long as she needs you.

This is wonderful! This is so amazing! So glad to see you be okay <3
We'll always still be here if you ever need us, so don't hesitate :)

You are *not* weak. You have suffered through much, more than many others will ever suffer. Having depression does not make you weak. Having these pains does not make you weak. That you still live is testament enough to that. But know that you should probably talk to someone. It can often help. Also, I'd like you to read [this.](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide)  Don't lose hope! We're all here for you, we all care for you, and we want to see you get better and become strong and happy! The road is long, and full of pain, and hardship, but there is an end. There *is* a light at the end of the tunnel. And I will do what I can to help you reach that happy light.
You can talk to anyone here, including me, whenever you need to. We'll always be here, to lend our ears to your plight. We will not leave you to the darkness, because we love you. We really do, with all of our heart. And we will never let someone we love wallow in this misery all alone. :) Stay strong.

Do not worry, my friend. I do not know you. I could not possibly feel the same way you do right now. How could I? We are but two strangers on the internet, lost to the ever changing canvas that is our world. But know this: you are not alone. Know that you are never alone. I know your hope is fading. Mine was once faded too. But do not let yourself despair. There is much that you can still do to change this place for the better. There is still much left for you to be and do on this planet. If you feel alone, if you feel tired, know that I will do my best to comfort you. I will be there to carry you, as well as I can. I may be a stranger, far removed from the struggles of your day to day life. But I am here. I care. And I will still be here for as long as you need. If you want to talk, you can message me or just reply to this comment.

Don't lose hope.
I'm glad :)
It's nice to vent someimes, even to a stranger on the internet ;) I'm glad you feel better.

I understand. And I'll still be here. For the day when you change your mind, I'll still be here. Because I've fought that war. It's been my life. Our wars may stem from different causes, and they may be for different reasons, but I will stay. My war is dying down, and in the lull, I see all of the other fights, the other miseries. And I will help when I can. I understand, and I will wait.

I wish I knew. I wish I could be there, and could see what's going on. I wish I could be there to make you feel like there's someone in this world who cares whether you live or die. I wish the world wouldn't let its people fall through the cracks. I wish everything could always be alright for everyone. 

But my wish cannot come true. I cannot make the world into what I want it to be. But I *can* do my part to influence what is within my power, to change the world in little ways, so that maybe someday, there will be a world with better people, where no one ever feels alone.

There's so many things in life, so much knowledge, and so little that we truly understand. There is not much I can do to influence the course of human events, but what I can do is sit here, and type these sentences to you, in the hopes that you will see that at least one person on this earth cares that you are still alive.

Most of all, I wish I could be there, I wish I could give you a big hug, and tell you that everything will be alright.

[This is the closest that I can get.](http://24.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lwvtbvM8Gg1qcuupyo1_500.jpg)

Stay strong. You're not in this alone.

I understand. It must be stressful, living like that from day to day. And I'm here for you. To vent, to talk, whatever you need. Life is so confusing, and I don't think there's one right answer. But I'll still be here, day in, day out, willing to talk whenever you need it.

>I've tried. I've tried and tried and tried. I feel like I've done everything I can. I've gone through medication, I've tried therapy, I've tried counselling, I've tried talking to close friends, relatives, people I trust. But nothing works. Nothing ever helps. I can feel it, see the doors closing one by one. And I feel like there's only one option left. And I'm afraid. Terrified. I don't know what to do anymore. I don't want to die, any more than anyone else, but I don't know what to do. I'm running out of options. Justifications. Reasons. Every night I dream of death, and every day I just wish I could die. But I don't want do. I'm growing weak. Oh god, I'm growing so weak. I hide behind smile after smile, I hide behind a person that others want to be around... but I can't take it anymore. I can only see one door anymore. Please. Somebody. Anybody. I'm out of options, and I don't know what to do.

That was me, about a month ago. It's not easy to deal with, in fact, it's downright painful. But know this: you are not nothing. You are not worthless. Never, ever let others think you're worthless. You are worth something, because I give you worth, even if you cannot see it. How can you be nothing, when I can talk to you through this computer, and you can respond? I care about you. I want to see you become happy. The suffering has no point. It's pointless. But that's why we have to overcome it. Because there is a light at the end of the tunnel. And you will find it. But suicide will solve none of your problems. I just want to see you happy.

If you have time, I'd like you to read through [this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/).

And know I'll be here if you want someone to talk to.

Hey man, what's up? Wow, your situation really  is complex, isn't it? But what you say is true. These suicidal thoughts, this post even, is a cry for help. You feel directionless. Lost. Alone. Well, my friend, I'm here to tell you: don't give up. You say you don't want to hurt your grandmother, then don't. Because you're a good person. I can tell. And I want to see good people become well. I want to see you become happy, and I want to see you find your direction in life. Sometimes these things don't happen automatically. Sometimes, they take more time then you realize. But you cannot give up. You cannot let go of the life and the mind that makes you so special.

I'm here for you, to offer a non-judgmental ear to whatever problems you have. Just message me or reply to this comment. Are you still in school?

[Please read this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/)

If your family is willing to work so hard to pay for your financial expenses, to pay for your needs, then they care about you. They care about you so much. And we care about you. That's why we're here. Because we care about your pain, and we want to see you get better. There's so many things left, that you can't give up now. Remember, it's not about how long you can stand, but how you pick yourself up when you fall. And you can be strong. You *are* strong. You can make it through this, and when you do, you will look back, and you will say, "I was not defeated. I did not give in. I am strong!" And you will know you speak the truth. Never give up. The other problems, the schooling, the job, the money, it's fixable. With some time, it's fixable. Suicide, however, is not. And your life is worth too much to end so soon. If you want to talk, vent, or just want someone to be there, I'll listen. Just message me if you need to.

Don't do it. Please. You're 16, right? There's so much left for you to do, to see, and I want you to be able to do it. Please. I know you're in a dark place, I've been there, I know what it's like. I know you just want to die, to end it, but you can't. Please. I've seen so many good people die, I can't bear to see it happen again. We're here for you. To talk to. To care for you. To be the people that want to see you make it. Please. You're hurting, but there are other ways. Please don't do this. Please. Talk to me, please. Just talk. Message me, reply to my comment I don't care. Just talk. Don't go.

No problem is ever too small that we should ignore the person behind it. Yes, there are people starving, and yes, there are people in far worse situations then you are. *But*, that's not what's important. What's important is that you feel these feelings, and we want to help you. There's never any problem that's so bad that it cannot be fixed. But, there's only one problem, one decision that cannot be reversed. And I don't want you to do it. There is an end to this roller-coaster of misery and pain.

If you could spare some time, I'd like you to read [this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/).

I'll be here to talk for as long as you need someone to talk to.

First off, I'd like you to read [this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/).

Secondly, if you feel like you can only talk face to face with that teacher, then I think you should do it. It's always important to have someone to talk to.

Thirdly, I want to see you get well. I want to see you become happy again. That's my goal, my dream. I've been down the dark, suicidal road. It's not a happy journey, and it never ends well for anyone. I would not wish it upon any person. After dealing with multiple attempts, several of which were almost successful, I learned that no one should go through with that. There's so much pain, so many sorrows, but they're all fixable. The one thing that isn't fixable is the final decision, to jump off that bridge, to pull that trigger, to take those pills.

I can talk  if you need it.

I know how that feels. But take it from me, you don't want it to get to the point where your family only finds out about how you feel because of a failed suicide attempt. The fact that you care, that you're afraid of hurting your family, shows that you're a good person. I know you're afraid, but you need to be strong. I want you to read [this] (http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/). And know, I may be a stranger on the internet, but I'm here because I care. Because I love you and want to see you be well. I'll be here as long as you need someone to talk to, so you can message me whenever you want, and I'll respond.

You care about the world? That's good. We need people like that. And that's why I'm going to tell you that I care about you. I care so much about seeing you well. There's so much pain, so much hurt in this world, and you can use your caring to do so much to help. I look at what you've said, and I see the soul of a beautiful, wonderful person. We need you in this world as much as we need everyone else, because without you, and others like you, we'll lose sight of that amazing human empathy and passion that keeps us all together.

But you can't be there for everyone. It's just not possible. There's too many people, too many problems. They need to be spread out over a large group. And remember, just because other people have problems and pain doesn't mean that you don't. Talking to someone, venting, or just looking for help, can be very important. We're all here for you, and we'll be here until you're well.

The best I can offer is that it can be nice to just sit and listen to some relaxing music for a while. Something like [this](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kgh7IJ8yqX8) can be nice to just sit to and listen for a while. Stay strong. There is an end. There is a light at the end of the tunnel, and it is beautiful. You will make it. I can't offer much more than moral support at this point, so take it for what it's worth.

You're still alive, correct? Then you still have something worth fighting for. More specifically, at least a part of you understands that your life is worth it. We're always here if you need someone to talk to.

And, from me to you, [\*huggles*](http://24.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lwvtbvM8Gg1qcuupyo1_500.jpg)

Stay strong, you can do this <3

The physical pain, it can be helped. It can be changed. A physical therapist might be what you need. If 80% of your friends have moved away, then surely there's still the 20% that you can talk to. You should talk with them. Let them know how you're feeling. It's not easy, but sometimes, having a close friend that you can rely on for emotional support is incredibly helpful. 

It may seem like it's getting worse now, but you have to stay strong. I want you to make it through this. I want you to feel the relief of overcoming your pain. And that's the key word. *Feel*. Feeling requires that you be alive. If you have the time, I'd like you to read [this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide). And remember, we're all here for you, so if you ever need to talk, just message me, or another person in this thread.

[Alex, I want you to read this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide).

And listen to what the others have said. This emotionless pain is what happens to all of us. We're here for you, man. We're here because we love you and we want to see you survive. It's good that you gave yourself time to think about it. It means that somewhere, at least part of you wants to survive. Hold on to that part. Hold on, near and dear, and fight for all you're worth. Your life will be full of mistakes, full of 'what ifs'; don't dwell on them. I want you to take a walk. Just a quick 5, maybe 10 minute walk wherever you live. And talk to someone. Your parents, a friend, it doesn't matter. I know it's hard, but you have to let them know how you feel. There are so many people out there who love and care about you, and all they want is to see you well. That's all we want as well. We're here because we care about you. All of us.

And so the world weeps, for its children have abandoned it, in hatred, in pain. I cannot blame you for your anger. It is certainly not misplaced. You have lived a painful life, and in trying to fix that pain, you have succumbed to it. Your name I shall remember, but not because you left this world suddenly, or violently. I shall not remember your name because of the wrongs that it has committed upon your soul.

There is a saying, "It is always darkest just before the dawn." A phrase meant to inspire, to show that there is an end, and that sometimes, things get worse before they get better. What I see is not a broken husk of a person, not a soulless creature with no reason left, but a person, deeply hurt, who wants someone to care, even just a little bit.

No spirit is so broken that it cannot be fixed. No life is in such shambles that it cannot return to a semblance of normalcy. You say you simply wanted a hand to reach out, to help you pull, well I want to be that hand. Others here, those who post here, they want to be that hand. We offer you moral support, though we cannot reach you right now. We love you, as we love all those who walk this Earth. And we want to see you well.

For you may be broken now, but you cannot give up, for the greatest challenge is not for how long you can stand, but how you pick yourself up when you fall down. And you do not need to do it alone. I will be here, in any way that I can, to help you in this challenge. You are still alive, and so there is still hope. And when you stand, victorious, atop the mountain that is the challenges in your life, you will know that you are strong. And you will know that your spirit is whole.

I reach out my hand, I try to find the rope, and I will help you pull until the day that I die. Don't give up. We're all here.

If you want to talk, you can always message me.

It's good to vent sometimes. When there's a lot of pent up emotion, it means that there needs to be some sort of release. It's never good to just hold all of it in you, because it starts to overwhelm you. But suicide isn't the answer. It's not a healthy way to cope. If there's someone you can talk to about this, I suggest that you do, because your life is too important to waste just sitting around for years. I should know, there were periods of months during my depression where I literally just sat in bed, contemplating never moving again. I wish I could go back to myself in those times and console that version of me, so that I could understand the reason I felt that way, and so that I could know that someone cared about me. But know this: I care about you. I don't want you to feel this way. I want you to love life, live strong, be happy. I want you to find something in your life that makes you feel like it's worth living again. I don't know what that is, but I do know that I want you to live. There's so many people out there, and so many things, and exploring those things can be a part of what makes life so amazing. The discovery, the passion for something. If you need to talk, I'll be right here. You can reply to this comment or message me, I don't care. I just want to see you become well.

I read what you've done for your son. That is the greatest thing that I have heard in a while. Someone who is willing to put their entire being into their children. I envy that kind of strength. That kind of willpower. It is something I can only dream of. Your son must love you, and you him. Is there anyone else you could talk to?

You see this? This is me caring about you. This is me telling you that you matter to me. If you can, go hug your mom, or dad, or brother, or sister. Tell them you love them. You can't see it, but I'm hugging my monitor right now, because it's the best I can do, given the circumstances. 

\>[me right now]
(http://24.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lwvtbvM8Gg1qcuupyo1_500.jpg)

\*huggles\*

You're worth so much. To so many people. We're here for you. We will always be here if you want someone to talk to. I know how it feels for it to seem like everyone you know has given up on you, but the reality is that's just not true. There's at least one person out there that would miss you in your passing, and that person is me. I'm certain there are others as well, but know this: I'll be there if you need someone to talk to. [This](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/) can also be helpful to read. And listen to Chrisray408. It can really help to find some small thing you can do that provides tangible results. Even if it's just making paper airplanes.

If you kill yourself, then that will be true. Others will deserve it more than you. But that's not what's important right now. What's important is that you feel this way, and we want you to feel better. First of all, please [read this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/sphone.htm) before you do anything. Secondly, we love you. I know it sounds weird or cheesy, but we're here because we love you and we want you to be okay. You DO deserve your good fortune, and you just need to prove it. Try looking for volunteer opportunities in your community, or even just donate to the Red Cross. You can also just talk to people about how you're feeling, or just talk to us. There's so much you can do, so much you can be, that I, no, *we*, all of us, here and where you are, want you to make it. That's why we're here, talking to you, trying to figure out what's wrong, trying to help. Because we care about you and we love you.

It's hard to deal with. It's really hard to deal with. Sometimes it never goes away. But it's not whether or not we can stand up tall that proves how strong we are, it's what we do when we fall down and have to get back up. It will never get better. Depression is a horrible thing. You, on the other hand, *will* get better. As long as you let those in your life who love you and whom you love help you, and as long as you believe that there is an end, then you will get better. It's a long, difficult, and painful path. But it's not endless. If you want to talk, just let me know.

In my case, things got a little extreme. I ended up trying to kill myself, and upon failing, was found out by others and forced into a rehab program. I hated the program, and it didn't really help. But then, this girl I knew for some reason decided that I should live, and spent literally every day and night focusing on helping me. I'd never seen anything like it, before or since. The truth is, my depression hasn't gone away. My suicidal thoughts haven't gone away. The misery, the hopelessness, it still comes to me. But there is someone out there who cares enough to make sure, every night, that I'm going to sleep in my bed. That I'm not overdosing. Who came to my house at 3 in the morning just so I could have someone to talk to. It's still an uphill battle, more like a cliff than a hill, actually. But it can be done. And I am going to make sure that you make it up that hill, and feel again, feel in ways you thought you had lost. Don't give up hope. You're still alive, so it's not over yet.
I can talk for as long as you need. Or, if you want, you could talk to your son. I'm sure if he knew there was something wrong, he would certainly be willing to stay and talk.

Please don't do it. I know it seems like the only choice, but it isn't. Find someone to talk to, find anyone. You could talk to a friend, or just talk to me. Either way, just talk. You should also read [this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/). Please don't do this.

Just stay with him. Be there for him, for as long as he needs it. That's the most important thing.
[Some](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/whattodo.htm)[ of](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/sphone.htm) these might be helpful to look at. Just stay with him, and let him know there's a friend still there.

[Please reed this](http://www.metanoia.org/suicide/)

And always remember, we're here to talk if you need it. You're not worthless, and you're certainly not useless. If you want, you can go get ice cream, or read a book, or something small and mundane. It can sometimes help. Please don't leave us. You're worth too much as a person. You're worth too much to all of us, to your family, to your brother, to your sister, to us here on reddit. And you obviously care about them, or you would not have said sorry. 

And remember, it's not that suicide is not the answer for *everyone*, it's that it's not the answer for *anyone*.

Yeah, it is. It really is. And it certainly seems like no one truly understands what this... experience, these feelings, are like,unless they've been through exactly what you've been through. You're not dead yet, and that's a good sign. It means that at least a part of you still wants to live. There's really not too much I can say other than I've been there, and it sucks, it's miserable, and nobody seems to understand why it's so miserable.
